summary: Indaptus Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $100 million of common stock through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The offering replaces a prior ATM agreement and is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415. The filing includes prior sales and a 3% commission but does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer raising capital in the open market, with no deal terms or strategic event.
